description: This file provides an API client module for making HTTP requests (GET and POST) to a backend API, including error normalization, logging, and a React hook for usage within React components.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages based on the current log level, avoiding sensitive data.

methods.name: normalizeError
methods.description: Creates a standardized Error object with additional metadata.

methods.name: parseJsonSafe
methods.description: Safely parses JSON from a response, fallback to raw text if parsing fails.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Internal function performing fetch requests with error handling and logging.

methods.name: apiGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the API.

methods.name: apiPost
methods.description: Performs a POST request to the API.

methods.name: createApiClient
methods.description: Creates a scoped API client with a custom base URL.

methods.name: useApi
methods.description: React hook returning API helper functions.
